FEZZTITGE

Intro Date -
June (8, 2025

ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be
amended by changing all the RS-2 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 28-H in the area bounded
by

A public alley next north of and parallel to West Edmaire Street; a line 303.5
feet east of and parallel to South Vincennes Avenue; West Edmaire Street;
and a line 266 feet east of and parallel to South Vincennes Avenue

to those of a RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.

Common Address of Property: 1746 West Edmaire Street
